page_title: BIL 2-2 GET | Athletic Bilbao v Getafe 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Calf Injury

commentary.text: 90+10' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Jaime Mata (Getafe) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' That's it for today, Isidro Diaz de Mera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
90+6' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+6' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera has finally had enough of Jose Bordalas Jimenez and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+6' Booking. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a caution from the referee.
90+6' Having seen unsporting behavior, Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Omar Alderete (Getafe) is the recipient.
90+5' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' Djene (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+2' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+2' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' A cross from a corner kick by Getafe is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
87' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
85' Alex Berenguer comes off the pitch to be replaced by Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
85' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jaime Mata (Getafe) replacing Nemanja Maksimovic.
83' Although Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) is just on the bench, Isidro Diaz de Mera has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
83' 2 - 2 Goal! Jose Angel Carmona picks out Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the left side of the goal with a header from close range. 2:2.
82' Substitution. Ander Herrera makes his way off the pitch and Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) comes on as his replacement.
81' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and Ath Bilbao manage to earn a corner.
80' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as David Soria (Getafe) leaps to collect the ball.

79' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez is replaced by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe).
77' A substitution has been made. Mauro Arambarri is replaced by Djene (Getafe).
75' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
73' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
71' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) places a close-range header from a rebound onto the crossbar!
69' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

68' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.
66' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Carles Alena can be given a rest.
65' Fabrizio Angileri goes off the pitch and Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) comes on.
65' A substitution has been made. Gorka Guruzeta goes off and Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
65' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) replaces Mikel Vesga.

62' 2 - 1 Oscar de Marcos passes to Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:1.
62' The attendance for today's match is 43091.
58' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
57' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
56' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) commits a foul during an attacking move.
54' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz de Mera no option but to blow his whistle.
53' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

51' 1 - 1 Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
51' The ball goes out of play and Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Diego Rico (Getafe) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
46' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor makes a half-time substitution. Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) comes on in place of Aitor Paredes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is sent off by the referee for a disgraceful tackle that simply has no place in football!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
44' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
40' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will take a throw-in.

37' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, David Soria makes a great save to stop his effort.
35' Looks like Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

34' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
32' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

32' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past David Soria, who keeps it out.
30' Carles Alena (Getafe) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
29' A crossfield pass from David Soria (Getafe) fails to find any of his teammates. It's a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
27' Ath Bilbao hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

25' The ball has crossed the sideline. Ath Bilbao are taking a throw-in. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
22' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
20' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Ath Bilbao.
20' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Unai Simon comes off the line to clear the ball away.
17' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.

14' What a chance that is! Mason Greenwood (Getafe) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
14' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the middle of the net, but David Soria makes a decent save to stop the effort.
12' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
10' Carles Alena (Getafe) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
7' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Damian Suarez (Getafe) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.

6' 1 - 0 Alex Berenguer slides a pass towards Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom right corner. The score is now 1:0.
6' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
4' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
2' Chance! Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Unai Simon is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera will supervise the game today.
